title: Design System: Jocsan Perez Coto · Field Guide

display.purpose: The name on the opening spread only, two masked lines.

headline.purpose: Project names on their plates and the contact heading.

lead.purpose: The one paragraph under a heading, 34-52ch; 1.25rem on the hero summary.

body.purpose: Table values, lists and all running text.

label.purpose: Uppercase table terms and form field labels only.

numeral.purpose: Chip numbers, list ordinals and counts; always tabular.

motion.name: button-state
motion.value: 200ms ease-out; background-color, color, translate (-2px on hover)

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Name lines rising out of their masks.

motion.name: hero-fade
motion.value: GSAP expo.out 0.9s, y 18 -> 0 with fade, stagger 0.07s
motion.purpose: Lead, table and buttons settling on the opening page.

motion.name: page-open
motion.purpose: Opening plate page swinging onto the spine.

motion.name: page-turn
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub 0.6, rotateY -80deg -> 0, shade opacity 0.6 -> 0, top bottom -> top 35%
motion.purpose: Every later right page turning on the spine, 1024px and up.

motion.name: chip-stamp
motion.value: GSAP back.out(2) 0.45s, scale 1.6 -> 1 with fade, stagger 0.09s

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: In-page jumps from tabs and buttons.

components.css: .ds-figure { margin: 0; width: 320px; } .ds-figure-well { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 200px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14231a); background: var(--page-2, #e3ebe4); } .ds-figure-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--page, #f2f5f1); transition: transform 500ms ease-out; } .ds-figure-well:hover .ds-figure-img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-chip { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; min-width: 40px; padding: 0 8px; background: var(--ink, #14231a); color: var(--page, #f2f5f1); font: 700 1.125rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figure-cap { margin-top: 12px; font: 400 0.875rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #3d5446); }

components.css: .ds-class { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7.5rem, auto) 1fr; margin: 0; width: 420px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #14231a); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-class dt, .ds-class dd { margin: 0; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #14231a) 20%, transparent); } .ds-class dt { padding-right: 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ink-2, #3d5446); } .ds-class dd { color: var(--ink, #14231a); font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-class-ok { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-right: 8px; background: var(--ok, #1f7a46); }

components.name: Fore-edge Index Tabs
components.description: Orange thumb-index tabs; the active one stands further out and carries an ink notch.
components.css: .ds-index { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; width: 106px; padding: 0 0 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--tab, #f08a24); color: var(--on-tab, #14231a); font: 700 13px 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: width 300ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { width: 112px; } .ds-tab[aria-current] { width: 118px; } .ds-tab-notch { width: 10px; height: 10px; flex-shrink: 0; background: transparent; } .ds-tab[aria-current] .ds-tab-notch { background: var(--on-tab, #14231a); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tab, #f08a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Control Tab
components.description: Square page-coloured language and theme switches with a 2px ink frame.
components.css: .ds-controls { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-ctl { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14231a); border-radius: 0; background: var(--page, #f2f5f1); color: var(--ink, #14231a); font: 700 0.875rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ctl:hover { background: var(--page-2, #e3ebe4); } .ds-ctl:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--tab, #f08a24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Boxless field: a bottom rule that darkens to full ink on focus, uppercase label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 280px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ink-2, #3d5446); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #14231a) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14231a); font: 400 1.125rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #14231a); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a printed Costa Rican field guide to one developer. Every section is an open spread: two cool white plate pages bound on a near-black spine and laid on deep green bookcloth. The left page carries the legend (heading, prose, classification table); the right page carries the plate (specimen figures, the 3D model, a list), headed by a roman plate number. Projects are specimens: framed screenshots with a black number chip stamped into the corner and a "Fig. n." caption below.

The world is flat and printed. Colour is laid down as solid fields, never gradients; corners are square; depth exists only as the physical turn of a page on its spine. Type pairs a heavy, tightly tracked Bricolage Grotesque for names and headings with Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything that must be read. Density is calm: one heading, one paragraph, one hairline table per page.

The dark theme is the same book read at night: the page darkens to bookcloth green, ink becomes light, and the orange index tabs stay exactly as they are.
keyCharacteristics: Two-page spreads on a fixed 14px spine; pages stack with a 12px spine bar on narrow screens.
Flat solid fields only; square corners everywhere; 2px ink frames around every figure.
Black tabular number chips mark specimens; roman numerals mark plates.
Hairline classification tables (2px ink top rule, 1px ink/20 row rules) carry facts.
Toucan orange lives on the fore-edge index tabs, the focus ring and text selection.
Motion is physical: lines rise, pages turn on the spine, chips stamp in.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a solid field. No gradients, no tints layered for depth, no blur.

rules.name: The Index Orange Rule
rules.body: Toucan orange belongs to the index and to focus and selection. It never fills a button, a heading or a decoration on the page.

rules.name: The Night Book Rule
rules.body: The dark theme swaps values, never roles: the page takes the bookcloth green family, ink inverts to light, orange is unchanged.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for names, headings and numbers; Atkinson is for anything read as a sentence. Headings use balanced wrapping; paragraphs use pretty wrapping.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that labels or counts (chips, ordinals, stars, repository counts) is tabular.

rules.name: The Paper Has No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by colour fields, frames and the spine. Never add a box-shadow, glow or backdrop blur to a page, figure or control.

dos: Do build every section as a spread: legend page, spine, plate page, each opened by a folio.
Do frame every image, model or avatar in a 2px ink line over the page-2 well, and caption figures "Fig. n."
Do number specimens with the ink chip and plates with roman numerals, in reading order.
Do put facts in the classification table (2px ink top rule, 1px ink/20 row rules, uppercase 0.08em ink-2 terms).
Do keep Morpho Blue as the only interactive hue and underline every inline link.
Do show navigation state as a mark (notch, top bar, extra width), keeping the tab colour constant.
Do carry motion as physical paper: rise, turn on the spine, stamp; and skip it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use gradients, shadows, glows or backdrop blur on any surface.
Don't use Toucan Orange outside the index tabs, focus ring, selection and skip link.
Don't set sentences in Bricolage Grotesque or headings in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Don't put an uppercase label line above a heading; uppercase tracking belongs to table terms and field labels only.
Don't open a page with a dark hero, a gradient name or a row of translucent cards.
